event_chain.summary: Registrar removed confidential voter documents from office

summary: On June 4, 2026 Shasta County Registrar of Voters Clint Curtis removed from the Elections Office copies of documents containing confidential voter information (names, addresses, birthdates, phone numbers and signatures). The removal was identified during the election reconciliation process and the county reported it to the California Secretary of State on June 6, 2026. Curtis said the documents were copies he had secured to prevent alteration.
